metadata.workload: 23 fixed real-repository tool-result continuations plus closed-loop read/search tasks

limits: Controlled repository replay is not production traffic. Closed-loop continuations execute read/search tools but can follow different paths between models.
512-token response cap and 8-request closed-loop limit; no task-correctness score. Task completed flags only mean a final response was reached.
One replay pair had unequal fresh-token counts and must not enter matched-work latency ratios.
IQ3 repository decode medians differed between rounds; no continuous thermal monitoring. Do not attribute the drift to a measured cause.
